title: Org KPI Definitions (frontmatter)
description: Validates only the file-level frontmatter fields of org-kpi-definitions.md (parsed the same flat way as org-config.md, via parse_markdown_kv over the text preceding the first ```pipeline block). It does NOT validate the pipeline blocks themselves — each ```pipeline block should be extracted with run_analysis.py::load_kpi_pipelines and validated individually against kpi_pipeline.schema.json. Splitting the two schemas mirrors the file's own split between human-readable prose/frontmatter and machine-readable pipeline logic (D2).
